shortDescription: Create or delete IP addresses on interfaces

options.name: address
options.description: Address to assign Can be a stand-alone address or CIDR. If no CIDR is given, it's assumed to be /32. Required for both I(state)=C(present) and I(state)=C(absent). Should not be used for I(state)=C(flush)

options.name: dad
options.description: Enable or disable Duplicate Address Discovery for this address. Kernel default is 'enabled'.

options.name: home
options.description: Designates this address the "home address". IPv6 only.

options.name: label
options.description: Label, assosicated with address. Maximum length is 15 characters. In order to compatibility with Linux-2.0 net aliases, this string must coincide with the name of the device or must be prefixed with the device name followed by colon.

options.name: metric
options.description: Priority of prefix route associated with address.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of a new network device. Required for I(state)=present

options.name: namespace
options.description: Name of namespace where interface is. Namespace should exist

options.name: peer
options.description: Address of remote endpoint for point-to-point links.

options.name: preferred_lft
options.description: Preferred lifetime for the address. Address stop been used after expiration. Set to a number or C(forever). Default value in kernel is 'forver'.

options.name: prefixroute
options.description: Enable or disable automatic creation/deletion of a route for the network prefix of the address. Kernel default is 'eanbled'.

options.name: scope
options.description: Scope where address is valid. The available scopes are listed in file /etc/iproute2/rt_scopes. Predefined values are C(global), C(site), C(link), C(host).

options.name: state
options.description: Should address be addedd or removed. C(flush) removes all addresses from the interface. C(query) return list of ip addresses on interface (with prefixes).

options.name: valid_lft
options.description: Valid lifetime for the address. Address stop been used after expiration. Set to a number or C(forever). Default value in kernel is 'forver'.
